by-account: Keyed by an account (user_id). An agent's member row has no account, so these only ever reach people.
by-grant: Keyed by the caller's own membership: a person's connection grant, session, or the id requireMember/requirePerson already resolved. An agent principal never reaches these.
agent-owner: Joins members on an agent's owner_member_id. The owner is always a person.
owner-role: Filters role to owner or admin. An agent row's role is fixed at member by members_agent_shape (0040).
person-write: Inserts or updates a row the same transaction already found or created as a person.
whole-space: Asks whether any member row exists, or deletes every row of a space being deleted. Kind does not matter.
named-member: Reads one member a person-only record already names: an admission receipt, an owner replacement, a report's reporter.
